description: [Kyreos, 0.004 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Current exchange rates from one source (open.er-api), with the source name and timestamp on every response. Input: {"base":"USD","symbols":["EUR","JPY"]}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/fx-rates?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.004 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.
